record.paper_title: THE LYAPIN’S NOTEBOOK: A COLLECTION OF UNSOLVED PROBLEMS IN SEMIGROUP THEORY
record.context_brief: Endomorphism semigroups isomorphic to rational-additive semigroups
record.original_question: Describe commutative semigroups whose semigroup of endomorphisms under pointwise multiplication is isomorphic either to the additive semigroup of all positive rational numbers or to the additive semigroup of all non-negative rational numbers.

evidence.quote:
Problem 3.9. (A.A. Borisov) Describe commutative semigroups whose semigroups of endomor-
phisms (with pointwise multiplication) are isomorphic to one of the following semigroups:

    (1) the additive semigroup of all positive rational numbers;
    (2) the additive semigroup of all non negative rational numbers.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a commutative semigroup $S$, let $\mathrm{End}(S)$ denote the set of all semigroup endomorphisms $f\colon S\to S$, equipped with the binary operation of pointwise multiplication, namely $(f\cdot g)(s) = f(s)g(s)$ for all $s\in S$ (where the product on the right is taken in $S$). Since $S$ is commutative, this operation makes $\mathrm{End}(S)$ into a semigroup.

Describe, up to isomorphism, all commutative semigroups $S$ such that $\mathrm{End}(S)$, with the above pointwise multiplication, is isomorphic to:

(1) the additive semigroup $(\mathbb{Q}_{>0}, +)$ of all positive rational numbers; or

(2) the additive semigroup $(\mathbb{Q}_{\ge 0}, +)$ of all non-negative rational numbers.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a recent compilation of unsolved problems from Lyapin's notebook on semigroup theory, attributed to A.A. Borisov. Available literature on Borisov's work on E-semigroups and on commutative semigroups whose endomorphisms are power functions does not record a solution describing the commutative semigroups whose endomorphism semigroup under pointwise multiplication is isomorphic to $(\mathbb{Q}_{>0},+)$ or $(\mathbb{Q}_{\ge0},+)$. No published resolution was found.
